Subject: Lakeside: mutual agenda & implementation timeline

Alex — following up from our demo, attaching a draft mutual agenda so we can agree milestones and owners. High level proposal below; attached is a one-sheet MAP (Lakeside-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a placeholder SOW draft for procurement to review.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Week 0 (Jun 21): Contract/PO confirmed and SOW accepted — Lakeside: Purchasing; Redwood: Stephanie (primary contact)
- Week 1 (Jun 28): Tech kickoff — Redwood eng + Lakeside infra team (setup staging environment, access lists)
- Week 2–3 (Jul 5–19): Integration sprint 1 — API ingestion, data schema, test prompts; Owners: Redwood Eng (Ben), Lakeside Eng (Alex)
- Week 4 (Jul 26): Validation & QA — joint test cases, acceptance criteria signoff; Owners: Monica (CS) + Lakeside PM
- Week 6 (Aug 9): Production cutover window — playbook and rollback plan

Open items for Lakeside: data retention & retention window, expected volume (tokens/day), and which internal teams need SSO/SAML. If we can get those answers by next Tue (Jun 19) we’ll lock dates and circulate meeting invites.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alex to confirm procurement timeline and any legal review heads-up
2) Lakeside to confirm SSO/KMS needs (if any)
3) Redwood to provision staging and propose three kickoff slots

Attachments: Lakeside-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-draft-Lakeside.pdf (SOW placeholder)

Thanks — happy to adjust.

—
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Alex Guerrero <alexg@lakeside.ai>

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear draft. Quick replies inline.

- PO: Procurement is initiating the PO process today; I expect a signed PO by Jun 24. CC'd purchasing so they can confirm timelines.
- SSO: We use Okta; SAML required for prod and staging. I'll pull our infra lead onto the kickoff.
- Volume: Initial pilot at ~500k tokens/week, 1–2M tokens/month if pilot succeeds.
- Retention: We need a 30-day KV cache retention at minimum, and logs retained for 90 days. Is that supported?

Also: can you confirm whether the staging environment will mirror our US-East production? We prefer minimal drift.

Looping in with technical notes and proposed owner assignments.

Stephanie — thanks for the MAP. Notes:
- KV cache retention: we support configurable TTLs up to 90 days, but retention >30 days increases storage footprint; estimate +12% token-storage cost for 90 vs 30 days. I'll provide a short cost delta table before EOD.
- Staging: will be us-east-1 on a near-production hardware profile. We’ll seed a representative subset of data for validation.
- SSO/SAML: I’ll reach out to Alex’s infra lead and share Okta integration steps and a minimal test plan.

Proposed owners:
- Provisioning staging & access lists — Ben Carter (Redwood Eng)
- Integration sprint 1 (API, auth) — Ben + Lakeside Eng
- QA acceptance criteria & runbook — Monica Patel (CS) + Lakeside PM
- Cutover runbook & rollback team — Monica + Redwood Oncall (TBD)

I’ll draft a kickoff agenda with three proposed times and post it to the Drive folder (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_map_folder

3) Kickoff: proposed slots next week (all times PT): Mon Jun 21 09:00–10:00, Tue Jun 22 11:00–12:00, Wed Jun 23 14:00–15:00. Please confirm preferred slot and we’ll send calendar invite with Zoom link and an agenda.
